title: The mechanism registry validator checks the shape of the optional per-mechanism summary
summary: validate() requires a present summary to be a non-empty single-line string; absent stays valid.

title: A world-term glossary registry the website wiki can render: term, plain description, source pointer
summary: A separate append-only world_glossary.jsonl with its add/list tool, tests and role routes; no seed rows.

title: The week close also sweeps the main checkout's role_boundary.jsonl, and W44/W45 are re-closed to back-fill the rows it missed
summary: role_boundary joins the main-checkout sweep; W44 and W45 re-closed as back-fill (2 rows, the late 35-row W45 tools shard).

title: The retro nudge takes its cutoff from the newest RETRO-YYYY-Www week name, not from a file's mtime
summary: The retro nudge cutoff is the end of the newest retro's ISO week, so a git sync no longer moves it.
